)
USING DELTA

    batch = []
    batch_size = 50

        batch.append(row)

                f"('{r['row_id']}', '{r['name']}', {r['balance_eur']}, {r['updated_at']})"

            insert_stmt = f"""

                    statement=insert_stmt,
                    wait_timeout="60s"
